shortDescription: Creates an installable image of the root volume group

options.name: file
options.description: Specifies the directory on which the image is to be stored. When I(mksysb=yes), specifies the file name.

options.name: nopack
options.description: When I(mksysb=yes), specifies the list of files to exclude from being packed.

options.name: savemedialib
options.description: Specifies whether to save the contents of the media repository as part of the C(backupios) process.

options.name: savevgstruct
options.description: Specifies whether to save the volume groups structure of user-defined volume groups as part of the C(backupios) process.
